scope: Implementation and technical verification interval, including development, debugging and external waits; earlier planning and subsequent manual review were not separately timed.
overlap_note: Real evaluation processes briefly overlapped; durations must not be added to wall time.
environment_recovery: Existing local proxy and model selection used only in process environment; no account configuration copied.
publishing_note: Includes initial push, public CI diagnosis, cancellation-injection fix and local 50-test rerun. Final remote confirmation and packaging occur after this checkpoint.
completion_measurement_basis: Initial technical verification ends when the four cross-platform CI jobs completed successfully; earlier planning, implementation-only duration and subsequent manual review were not separately timed.
subsequent_document_review: The project author completed test-case review and manual user Q&A simulation, with usability feedback reflected in documentation; this activity was not separately timed.
